# sdachary.github.io — portfolio of S Deepak Achary

Human: Senior Data Analyst at Lloyds by day, AI architect and solopreneur builder by night.
Role: data analyst, AI architect, cloud infrastructure engineer.
Based in: Hyderabad, India.
